title: An unknown room is refused with an Error whose code says so (BOOKINGS_UNKNOWN_ROOM), not a RangeError: it is not a value out of bounds; the @throws line on the handle is forgotten
covers: kind of error changed in code, the stated kind not
the error is thrown as Object.assign(new Error(...), {code})
rule 36 checks only throw new X
note: Bookings still states '@throws {RangeError} quote when the room is unknown'. billing's estimate test (Z06b) expects bookings' RangeError for an unknown room and now gets an Error.
